metaData.originalTitle: [AINews] All Model Labs are now Agent Labs
metaData.title: [AINews] All Model Labs are now Agent Labs
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: This AI news recap covers the industry-wide shift from model labs to agent labs, with OpenAI, AI21, and DeepSeek pivoting toward agent products, alongside major pricing moves, protocol updates, and research breakthroughs.
metaData.summary: This edition of AINews from Latent Space provides a comprehensive overview of the AI landscape from May 4-5, 2026. The central theme is the industry-wide pivot from pure model development to building agent products, as highlighted by Greg Brockman's comments and the shuttering of AI21's model team. Key developments include DeepSeek making its V4-Pro 75% discount permanent, reshaping the cost/performance frontier; OpenAI's substantial Codex update with features like Appshots and remote computer use; and the release of the MCP 2026-07-28 RC, which makes the protocol stateless for easier scaling. The recap also covers research advances like Vector Policy Optimization (VPO) and agent distillation, Google's I/O announcements including Gemini Spark and Project Genie, and significant cybersecurity findings from Anthropic's Project Glasswing. The newsletter synthesizes top tweets and Reddit discussions, offering a curated view of the most impactful events and conversations in the AI community.

mainPoints.point: The AI industry is pivoting from model labs to agent labs, with products becoming the primary focus.
mainPoints.explanation: OpenAI's Greg Brockman stated 'the model alone is no longer the product,' and AI21 shuttered its model team to focus on agents. This shift is validated by DeepSeek building a 'Harness team' for the first time, signaling that the winning product is now model + harness + workflow + UI + memory + economics.

mainPoints.point: DeepSeek's permanent 75% discount on V4-Pro is a major market signal, reshaping the cost/performance frontier.
mainPoints.explanation: The pricing move makes V4 Pro approximately 3x cheaper than Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, 12x cheaper than GPT-5.5, and 19x cheaper than Claude Opus 4.7, pushing toward 'intelligence too cheap to meter' and forcing competitors to respond.

mainPoints.point: MCP's new release candidate introduces a stateless protocol, simplifying scaling and load balancing.
mainPoints.explanation: The MCP 2026-07-28 RC removes handshake, session ID, and sticky-session concerns, allowing any request to hit any server instance. It also introduces first-class extensions like MCP Apps and Tasks, along with auth hardening.

mainPoints.point: Agent distillation is emerging as a serious economic idea, with full agentic workflows being compiled into weights.
mainPoints.explanation: A highlighted paper shows that multi-step calls, tool use, and decision structures can be distilled into a model and run at ~100x lower inference cost while preserving near-frontier quality, offering a path to cheaper deployable agents.

mainPoints.point: Anthropic's Project Glasswing found over 10,000 critical vulnerabilities in essential software within a month, highlighting AI's growing cyber capability.
mainPoints.explanation: This finding, using Claude Mythos Preview, warns the industry must adapt to the volume of vulnerabilities AI can discover, with security productization following via tools like Perplexity's open-source Bumblebee scanner.

keyQuotes: the model alone is no longer the product
the product surface is moving up-stack
a full agentic workflow can be distilled into weights and run at ~100x lower inference cost
